name: Autopren DPDP Consent and Privacy Notices
author: autopren

sections.description:
Autopren DPDP Consent helps a website meet India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025:

  • A consent banner with Accept all, Reject all and Settings of equal weight, and a “Privacy settings” link on every page so visitors can change their mind.
  • Analytics and advertising scripts (Google Analytics, Site Kit, Meta Pixel and others) are held until the visitor agrees.
  • A notice line and an unticked consent box on Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms and Forminator forms.
  • Privacy notice and cookie notice pages from your Anupalan document set.
  • Optional: standard security headers and a simple login lockout for sites without a security plugin.

External services

This plugin connects to one external service: Anupalan, run by Autopren Systems (OPC) Private Limited at
https://anupalan.autoprens.com. It is used only if the site owner enters a site key in Settings, or if our team
sets the site up after the owner approves it. Without a site key the plugin contacts no one.

  • What it is for: loading the site’s consent banner settings, and keeping a record of each visitor’s consent choice
    so the site owner can show what consent was given (required by India’s DPDP Act).
  • Banner settings: the plugin requests https://anupalan.autoprens.com/consent/v1/config about once an hour,
    sending the site key.
  • Consent records: when a visitor accepts, rejects or changes their choices, the visitor’s browser sends to
    https://anupalan.autoprens.com/consent/v1/records the site key, the choices, a random identifier and the
    notice version. No name, email or full IP address is sent; the service keeps the IP address shortened to its
    network prefix.
  • Terms of service: https://anupalan.autoprens.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://anupalan.autoprens.com/privacy

The plugin also contains lists of third-party domains and cookie names (for example googletagmanager.com,
connect.facebook.net, youtube.com/iframe_api) in includes/data/trackers.php and assets/src/consent.js. These
are patterns used to recognise and hold back other plugins’ tracking scripts until the visitor consents. The
plugin never contacts these services and sends them no data.

Source code

The consent banner script assets/consent.js is minified. Its readable source is included in the plugin at
assets/src/consent.js and is also built from https://anupalan.autoprens.com (Autopren Systems). Rebuild with
any JavaScript minifier (we use esbuild: esbuild assets/src/consent.js --minify).
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • Setup by the Anupalan team through the WordPress REST API, after the site owner approves an application password.
  • Optional footer links to the notice pages.
